senses.gloss:
mn. (-णः-णं)
1 The ornamented arch of a door or gateway.
2 An outer door.
3 Decoration of the gate post.
4 A temporary and ornamental arch.
5 A mound or raised mark near a bathing place.
6 A triangle supporting a large balance.
n. (-णं)
The neck, the throat.
E.
तुर to hasten, affix ल्युट्; by which people pass or go.
